corpus.exclusionRule: Only Markdown documents under docs/ are governed corpus members. Root-level repository instruction files (README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are deliberately excluded: they are repository operating instructions whose governing content is already canonical within docs/ (see ADR-0001). Non-Markdown files under docs/ (none exist today) would be excluded as non-document artifacts.

documents.title: Huerta Group LLC — Documentation Index
documents.summary: Canonical index of governing and launch documentation: defines the document classifications, the five-level hierarchy of authority, canonical-location and no-duplication rules, and conflict escalation.
unresolved: No governing reference states a classification for the documentation index itself.
No governing reference states an authority tier for the documentation index itself.

documents.title: Huerta Group LLC Constitution (canonical record)
documents.statusNote: Records ratified Articles I–III by title only; the verbatim ratified text awaits insertion through the appropriate Company authority. The absence of the full text does not diminish the articles' ratified status.
documents.summary: The single canonical repository record of the Huerta Group LLC Constitution — the highest internal authority — with the rules governing the record itself.

provenance.approvalReference: Formally ratified per the document's own status statement; Articles I–III closed to ordinary revision.

documents.title: Vision Foundation for Development
documents.summary: Approved strategic foundation for all technology and development decisions: Company identity, value-creation model, technology/AI/software philosophy, and strategic guardrails.

provenance.approvalReference: Listed as Approved Strategic Authority by the documentation index (docs/README.md).

documents.title: Development Standards
documents.summary: How Huerta Group LLC systems are designed, implemented, reviewed, documented, and maintained: architecture, code quality, accessibility, security, AI use, content standards, deployment, and change control.

documents.title: Bounded Autonomous Completion and Verification Standard
documents.summary: Default execution method for consequential development tasks: the bounded builder–inspector–repair loop, verification requirements, protected actions, stop conditions, and evidence-based completion.

documents.title: Launch Readiness — Authoritative Record
documents.summary: Authoritative launch-readiness record: verified production state, route inventory, inquiry/notification standby state, environment-variable categories, navigation capacity, verified limitations, and protected owner decisions.

documents.title: Custom-Domain Migration Plan
documents.statusNote: Plan only; the intended domain is not owned, connected, or active. Execution requires owner authorization.
documents.summary: Owner-gated plan for migrating the public website from the active Vercel origin to the official custom domain: decisions, DNS/TLS, canonical cutover, verification, and rollback.

documents.title: Official Launch Checklist
documents.statusNote: Owner-gated items are never marked complete by development.
documents.summary: Phased checklist for the owner-authorized official launch: owner authorizations, pre-launch technical verification, domain migration, inquiry-notification activation, launch verification, and post-launch steps.

documents.title: Rollback Plan
documents.summary: Rollback procedures and responsibility boundaries for the public website: git, deployment-platform, environment, canonical-origin, and DNS rollback, with triggers and post-rollback verification.

documents.title: Internal Software Architecture Foundation
documents.summary: The technical architecture governing future Huerta Group systems: boundaries, data ownership, integration, environment, and identity direction, dependency sequencing, and the capability map. Authorizes no construction; creates no institutional authority.

documents.title: Architecture Decision Record Practice
documents.summary: When an ADR is required, naming and status conventions, required sections, supersession handling, knowledge-manifest integration, ratification rules, and the boundary between technical and institutional decisions.

provenance.approvalReference: Grounded in the Development Standards' written-decisions provision and the ADR-0001 precedent.

documents.title: ADR-0002 — Public Website Boundary
documents.summary: The public website remains a stable, bounded public interface; institutional systems are not built inside it by default; inquiry intake remains colocated with a recorded extraction trigger.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0003 — Application and Repository Boundary Strategy
documents.summary: No global repository topology is mandated; each future capability's application and repository placement is decided by its own ADR against explicit criteria; shared services are extracted only when a second real consumer exists.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0004 — Data Ownership and Supabase Boundary
documents.summary: The current Supabase project owns inquiry records only and is not the universal Company database; one authoritative owner per data category; future data topology remains unresolved with explicit criteria for deciding it later.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0005 — Environment Strategy
documents.summary: Production-first discipline is preserved for the public website; isolated environments, credentials, and migration testing become mandatory the moment any system stores client-confidential, learner, IP, identity, operationally consequential, financial, or regulated data.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0006 — Identity and Access Direction
documents.summary: Authentication arrives only with the first real consumer, then as a shared service; conceptual technical user classes are defined; technical permissions never constitute institutional authority; provider selection remains unresolved.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0001 — Institutional Knowledge Foundation
documents.summary: Architecture decision establishing the machine-readable institutional knowledge layer: metadata schema, corpus manifest, deterministic validation, identifier and relationship conventions, and explicit non-commitment to any future platform.

provenance.approvalReference: Created under the Development Standards provision for decision records under docs/development/.

documents.title: Methodology Foundation v1
documents.summary: The canonical repository record of the complete approved Methodology Foundation v1: definition and scope, five-layer architecture, work progression, asset distinctions, lifecycle, authority, disclosure, the eight initial Method Library records, technical boundaries, and unresolved matters.

provenance.approvalReference: Determination “METHOD LIBRARY FOUNDATION READY FOR TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION” transmitted with the Phase 3 implementing authorization (recorded in the document).

documents.title: Institutional Method Library — Technical Architecture
documents.summary: Technical architecture of the repository-based Method Library: record identity, registry/schema split, separate status dimensions, configurable approval representation, versioning and supersession handling, boundary preservation, and explicit non-authorization of any runtime system.

documents.title: mr-0002 — Institutional Methodology Definition and Scope
documents.summary: Approved internal doctrine: the §1.1 definition of institutional methodology, the ten approved scope domains, the §1.3 exclusions, and the technology-support boundary.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §§1.1–1.3 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: mr-0003 — Methodological Architecture v1
documents.summary: Approved internal framework: the five authoritative methodological layers (Doctrine, Domains, Asset Classes, Application Adaptations, Evidence and Evolution) with the §2.2 incomplete areas; explicitly incomplete by design.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §2 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: mr-0004 — Organizational Improvement Work Progression v1
documents.summary: Approved principle-level progression (understood, defined, examined, improved, implemented, verified, sustained, learned) as a non-numbered, non-automated reference framework.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §3 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: mr-0005 — Methodological Asset Classification Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved asset-type distinctions for Method Library records, with provisional candidate types recorded but not assignable.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §4 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: mr-0006 — Methodological Lifecycle and Maturity Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved lifecycle statuses and the five separate readiness designations; dimensions are never collapsed; superseded records are preserved.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §5 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: mr-0007 — Methodological Authority, Versioning, and Supersession Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved standard for methodological authority (interim configurable Founder rule), substantive-vs-clerical changes, versioning, supersession, and recorded disagreement.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §6 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: mr-0008 — Methodological Disclosure Classification Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved disclosure and adaptation distinctions; disclosure classes are handling classes, never legal claims; all initial records are internal.

provenance.approvalReference: Methodology Foundation v1 §7 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: Intellectual Property Foundation v1
documents.statusNote: Approved v1.0; the complete prose of the ten numbered sections (including the eleven architectural dimensions) awaits verbatim insertion through Intellectual Property authority (recorded in the document).
documents.summary: The canonical repository record of the approved Intellectual Property Foundation v1: IP governance structure, controlled vocabularies, status models, authority and disclosure boundaries, the six initial repository records, technical boundaries, and unresolved matters.

provenance.approvalReference: Determination “INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION V1 READY FOR TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION” transmitted with the Phase 4 implementing authorization (recorded in the document).

documents.title: Institutional Intellectual Property Repository — Technical Architecture
documents.summary: Technical architecture of the repository-based IP Repository: record identity, registry/schema split, separated status dimensions, authority/stewardship/custody roles, Corporate Headquarters boundary, admission process, and explicit non-authorization of runtime systems and legal determinations.

documents.title: ip-0002 — Institutional Intellectual Property Definition and Scope
documents.summary: Approved governing doctrine for institutional IP definition, admission criteria, scope, relationships, and exclusions; governs by reference pending verbatim insertion of the sectional text.

provenance.approvalReference: Intellectual Property Foundation v1 §§1.1–1.13 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: ip-0003 — Intellectual Property Asset Classification Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved asset classes (seventeen), classification principles, composite treatment, and provisional-class limitations for institutional IP records.

provenance.approvalReference: Intellectual Property Foundation v1 §3 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: ip-0004 — Intellectual Property Lifecycle Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved lifecycle states, IP governance statuses, nine independent readiness dimensions, maturity levels, supersession, and archival principles; dimensions never collapsed.

provenance.approvalReference: Intellectual Property Foundation v1 §4 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: ip-0005 — Intellectual Property Authority Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved admission requirements and authority boundaries among substantive rooms, IP authority, knowledge architecture, technical custody, and Corporate Headquarters; approval authority configurable.

provenance.approvalReference: Intellectual Property Foundation v1 §5 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)

documents.title: ip-0006 — Intellectual Property Disclosure Standard v1
documents.summary: Approved disclosure classifications with separate origin, adaptation, ownership, rights, and legal-confirmation treatment; no legal ownership or protection determinations.

provenance.approvalReference: Intellectual Property Foundation v1 §6 (authority basis recorded on the registry record)
